clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens savannas, raptors are hunted for their intact horns. Mebok Mizzyrix of Ratchet wants them for a scheme built on rumors of raptor intelligence.

Hunters prize raptor hides, talons, and trophies, but whole horns are harder to take in the field. Mebok Mizzyrix, an eccentric goblin alchemist in Ratchet, believes the Barrens raptors are more cunning than their kin elsewhere. He suspects their intellect lies in their horns. By grinding whole horns and brewing them into tonics, Mebok hopes to bottle that supposed genius in commercial drinks.

A horn fit for brewing must come from a particularly vicious predator, not just any young raptor. Sunscale Scytheclaws prowl the southern plains and the northern borders near Ashenvale. Takk the Leaper and the elusive Ishamuhale are notable terrors of the veldt, and their stout horns can survive the clash of the hunt intact.
